schema.title: string
schema.notApplicable: boolean — true for Ignore/Convert into Content/Convert into Product Idea; every field below is null when true
schema.primaryService: string or null — one of service-catalogue.json's primaryServices
schema.primaryServiceReason: string or null — which rule matched, for transparency
schema.secondaryServices: array of strings — natural follow-on services, ordered
schema.recommendedEngagementType: string or null — one of service-catalogue.json's engagementTypes
schema.estimatedProjectSize: string or null — Small, Medium, Large, or Enterprise
schema.projectSizeBasis: string or null — 'pipeline-revenue' (a real expectedRevenue figure) or 'heuristic-estimate' (Primary-Service default adjusted by the 0-10 expectedRevenue score) — never fabricated, always labelled
schema.recommendedProposalTemplate: string or null — a real filename in templates/proposals/
